title: Repair Staging Activation Gateway packaged runtime and stale-policy recovery

phases.objective: Make the server-governed Staging Activation Gateway dry-run build only from the generated service-local runtime bundle actually packaged under /app, and close the stale-policy circular recovery dependency by classifying signed JSON GATEWAY_POLICY_STALE health responses causally and routing stale Gateway drift to an exact-main, out-of-band server-side refresh workflow that performs a non-secret dry-run/preflight before any explicitly authorized Worker deploy. Keep all normal Gateway and Recovery routes fail-closed while stale and keep provider, database, DNS, custom-domain and Production mutation outside the dry-run.

e2e_journeys.actor: Server-governed Staging Activation Gateway dry-run authority
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dry-run can build the exact Staging Worker from /app/activation-gateway-runtime without reading /edge. A stale but cryptographically identified Gateway health response is classified as reachable-but-stale rather than generic unreachability, and convergence selects the exact-main out-of-band Staging Worker refresh workflow with a same-run non-secret dry-run/preflight before any separately authorized deploy. No launcher/provider mutation occurs.
steps: Synchronize worker-staging.mjs into the service-local activation-gateway-runtime bundle with the canonical bundle generator.
Resolve the bundle builder default root to http-generic-api/activation-gateway-runtime rather than the repository parent.
Retain repositoryRoot only as an internal test/development injection that still resolves through the service-local bundle.
Build the exact-SHA Staging bundle and policy identity from the packaged runtime files.
Run runtime-bundle parity and Staging governed-convergence regressions before any live retry.

Treat only an object-valued HTTP 503 carrying GATEWAY_POLICY_STALE, or an activation-gateway /health body with stale=true, as reachable-but-stale; keep TLS/network failures, 502 and unrelated non-success responses classified as gateway_health_reachable failures.
Prioritize the stale-policy handoff over other governed Gateway drift so an exact-commit mismatch cannot send execution back through the stale Activation Gateway.

Bind the immutable convergence plan execution surface to staging_activation_worker_workflow for stale recovery while keeping the same server-resolved Staging Worker target and caller_target_override_allowed=false.

Run activation_worker_refresh_dry_run on exact current main with exact policy hash and environment convergence plan SHA-256, build the signed bundle in memory, publish only non-secret evidence, and perform no provider access.

Require deploy_activation_worker to depend on the same-run refresh preflight, require explicit typed confirmation, exact current main, exact policy hash and plan SHA, then verify public exact-SHA/policy health if a later apply is separately authorized.

Validate the current origin trust contract as mad4b.staging.activation-recovery-origin-trust.v2 and explicitly allow only the safe provider_credentials_included=false metadata field in the secret-name guard.

Bind the server-resolved execution target and Staging apply adapter to the packaged runtime worker and policy paths, while retaining edge/activation-gateway only as the canonical source identity checked by parity.

Project a Staging-only private System Tool named prepareStagingActivationGatewayDarkDeployDryRun that delegates to the same server-resolved Gateway preflight implementation used by the dedicated Recovery route.

Expose only expected_source_commit, expected_policy_hash and environment_convergence_plan_sha256 on that System Tool; account_id, script_name, workspace_id, resource_binding_id, capability_envelope_id, execution_nonce and confirmation remain server-controlled or unavailable on the dry-run surface.

Pass the authenticated principal and the same server-side preflight dependencies through the Recovery System Tool overlay so workspace and profile authority are resolved identically to the dedicated Admin route.

Add v_platform_capability_readiness_vector to the Staging runtime optional read surfaces so the role receives SELECT only when the view exists; a missing view remains non-blocking degraded evidence and never expands schema privileges.

Package an allowlisted canonical-knowledge snapshot from the exact secret-free Git-archive build context under /app/repo-inspect, and set REPO_INSPECT_ROOT there so Staging repo_inspect list/read/search can resolve the required repository-root references instead of failing ENOENT against the flattened service image.

Treat environment_convergence_plan_sha256 as an operator acknowledgement candidate only: reconstruct the authoritative current plan first, require exact digest equality, and never treat the digest itself as provider execution authority.

Read only the profile-owned activation-dev.mad4b.com/health surface, require cryptographically identified GATEWAY_POLICY_STALE service identity, and reconstruct the current Staging convergence plan through the shared environment convergence engine.

Accept acknowledgement only when the operator-supplied plan digest exactly matches the workflow-owned current plan; then require status=handoff_ready with acknowledged_for_handoff while operator_acknowledgement_is_execution_authority remains false.
Bind source SHA, canonical policy SHA, authoritative convergence-plan SHA and deterministic Worker bundle SHA into a same-run preflight binding digest.

Pass authoritative_plan_sha256, worker_bundle_sha256 and preflight_binding_sha256 to deploy only through needs.activation_worker_refresh_preflight.outputs; rebuild the Worker artifact and verify the same binding before any provider API preflight or deploy.

When stale Gateway recovery is the selected first handoff, defer only gateway_recovery_trusted_ingress from the current plan digest because that local trust can only be re-certified after the Worker refresh; preserve it explicitly in deferred_reasons.

Keep the stale-worker plan hash portable across local One-Click and remote GitHub execution by binding it to the desired exact-main release commit, not to the obsolete observed Worker commit; retain the obsolete observed commit as evidence outside the plan hash.
assertions: The packaged runtime contains src/worker-staging.mjs and the bundle manifest covers it.
The server bundle builder does not construct edge/activation-gateway paths at runtime.
worker-staging.mjs, gateway.mjs and route-policy.staging.json remain canonical-source parity checked.
The repair does not weaken Gateway policy freshness, trusted ingress, caller target override, capability envelope or apply gates.
No Cloudflare/provider/DNS/database/Production mutation is performed by this source repair.
The generated service-local runtime bundle includes worker-staging.mjs and remains byte-identical to canonical edge source.
GATEWAY_POLICY_STALE does not weaken read_stale_grace_seconds=0 or mutation_stale_policy=deny; normal Gateway routes remain unavailable while stale.
A stale Gateway handoff uses staging_activation_worker_workflow through server_governed_out_of_band authority rather than activation_gateway_dark_deploy behind the stale Gateway.
When stale and exact-commit drift coexist, stale recovery is the selected next_governed_handoff regardless of failure ordering.
The stale refresh dry-run is exact-main and plan-bound, writes only no-secret evidence, and reports provider_accessed=false and provider_mutation_performed=false.
Worker deployment remains a separate consequential operation with explicit DEPLOY_STAGING_ACTIVATION_WORKER confirmation and cannot run unless the same workflow run completed the refresh preflight.
The Staging Worker workflow validates origin trust v2, policy hash, policy key, sourceCommit and workerBuildSha before classifying a later deploy as healthy.
AutoPilot/One-Click still never dispatches the stale recovery workflow, reads Cloudflare credentials, or performs provider mutation.

The stale-policy out-of-band handoff is scoped only to Staging; Production stale-policy classification remains on the production activation_gateway_dark_deploy authority and never routes through the Staging workflow.

The critical Staging Gateway repair declaration is registered exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths, with no broader control-plane pattern or autonomous merge authority.

The canonical Staging policy source remains under edge/activation-gateway, while every server-resolved execution bundle binding and adapter entrypoint resolves only through the packaged http-generic-api/activation-gateway-runtime tree.
A generic HTTP 503 with stale=true but without activation-gateway service identity is not sufficient to enter stale-recovery convergence.
The private Staging System Tool catalog contains prepareStagingActivationGatewayDarkDeployDryRun only in an unambiguous Staging environment and never in Production.
The Staging Gateway dry-run System Tool rejects caller-selected account, script, workspace, resource binding, capability envelope, execution nonce and confirmation fields before execution.
System Tool dry-run dispatch reaches the same server-resolved preflight path and preserves provider_accessed=false, provider_mutation_performed=false and production_authority=false.

v_platform_capability_readiness_vector is an optional Staging runtime SELECT-only surface; its absence cannot trigger broad schema grants and its presence does not grant INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL or GRANT OPTION.

The Staging image exposes repo_inspect source only from the exact Git-archive build context and the Docker context explicitly allowlists the required docs/canonicals/root knowledge files while ignored local material remains excluded.

A syntactically valid arbitrary convergence-plan digest is rejected unless it exactly equals the workflow-reconstructed current Staging plan; even a matching acknowledgement is never provider execution authority.
The stale-recovery preflight fails closed unless the profile-owned public health response identifies the activation-gateway service with stale=true and GATEWAY_POLICY_STALE semantics.
The workflow-owned convergence plan must reach handoff_ready with acknowledged_for_handoff before deploy outputs are emitted.
deploy_activation_worker consumes the authoritative plan and deterministic Worker bundle identity only from trusted same-run preflight outputs and recomputes the binding before provider access.

One-Click and the out-of-band workflow derive the same stale-worker plan identity even when local Recovery trust is stale: gateway_recovery_trusted_ingress remains visible but is topologically deferred and cannot silently disappear.

For gateway_policy_not_stale handoff, gateway_exact_commit drift has desired_release_commit equal to exact main and observed_release_commit null in the plan identity, while the actual stale Worker source remains visible in non-authoritative evidence.
Every Work Map output generated by the authorized exact-head autofix is explicitly declared in this PR scope and evidence set; no generated Work Map path is silently outside the E2E contract.

Cloudflare provider credentials are step-scoped only after same-run plan/bundle binding verification; validation, checkout, exact-main verification, bundle build and binding steps receive no Cloudflare credential environment.
e2e_journeys.objective: Make the server-governed Staging Activation Gateway dry-run build only from the generated service-local runtime bundle actually packaged under /app, and close the stale-policy circular recovery dependency by classifying signed JSON GATEWAY_POLICY_STALE health responses causally and routing stale Gateway drift to an exact-main, out-of-band server-side refresh workflow that performs a non-secret dry-run/preflight before any explicitly authorized Worker deploy. Keep all normal Gateway and Recovery routes fail-closed while stale and keep provider, database, DNS, custom-domain and Production mutation outside the dry-run. In the same governed journey, expose the exact Staging Recovery dry-run operation through the private System Tool catalog without falling back to the generic caller-account rollout contract; keep account, script, workspace, resource binding and apply authority server-resolved. Also keep live readiness diagnostics least-privilege by granting the Staging runtime role optional SELECT-only access to v_platform_capability_readiness_vector when that surface exists, and package only the allowlisted exact-build repository knowledge snapshot needed by repo_inspect list/read/search. The out-of-band stale apply no longer trusts a syntactically valid caller digest: the workflow reconstructs a live profile-owned Staging plan from exact-main plus Activation Gateway health, requires the operator-supplied digest to equal that authoritative plan before it can become acknowledged_for_handoff, then binds the verified plan to the deterministic Worker bundle SHA-256 and carries only trusted same-run job outputs into deploy. Stale-worker plan identity is also made portable across the local One-Click and remote workflow boundary by topologically deferring the local-only recovery-trust drift until after Worker refresh while retaining that drift as explicit deferred evidence.
